answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the trellis of a task receipt, and the vine is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the umber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
